verdict.rationale: Sentry documents Seer, an in-product AI debugging agent. Seer automatically root-causes issues, and its Autofix feature generates suggested code fixes for errors and performance issues using the user's Sentry data; AI code review is also offered. Seer requires a separate subscription. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, evidence of AI insights beyond debugging and root cause (e.g., trend or dashboard summaries), and detailed docs on the in-product insight experience.
